recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, close-up portrait of two individuals in a romantic, intimate pose, featuring a dark, moody background and vibrant, layered 80s-style typography at the top. The lighting is soft but directional, highlighting facial contours and eye clarity.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking heads creating a diagonal compositional line
Contrast between dark clothing/background and warm skin tones
Typographic layering reflecting the 'duo' theme through offset colors
Direct eye contact with the viewer from both subjects
coreInvariants: Soft-focus skin texture with sharp eye highlights
Offset 'shadow' effect on the main title text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale faces occupying 80% of the frame, one upright and one tilted horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the upper subject, which sit near the vertical center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, moves down to the upper face, follows the diagonal tilt to the lower face, and ends at the bottom metadata line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; concentrated in the upper corners and between the subjects' heads.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm peach and tan for skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric blue and coral red for the title text outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between skin and background; low saturation in the image, high saturation in the graphic elements.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to cool blues and warm reds for accents

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' has a very high horizontal bar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and tracking widths.
graphicDevices: Color-offset duplication of text to create a 3D/vibrating effect

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circular 'O' and 80s aesthetic.
Provides the clean, monolinear geometric skeleton.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic portrait of a man and woman. The man is looking forward with a slight tilt, the woman's head is tilted 90 degrees resting near his shoulder. Dark, moody studio lighting with deep shadows and soft highlights on skin. Background is a dark grey-blue gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large geometric sans-serif title in the upper third. Use an outline-only style in light blue, then duplicate the text in coral red and offset it slightly to the right and down. Add a small line of metadata text at the very bottom with extreme tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the title text double-layered with an offset?
Are the faces the primary focus with sharp eye detail?
Is the background dark enough to make the outlines pop?
Is the tracking on the bottom text wide enough?

adjustableVariables: Offset distance of the text shadow
Intensity of the blue/red color contrast
Angle of the lower subject's head tilt
Amount of grain in the photographic texture
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean, non-overlapping facial features
Ensure text is legible despite the offset effect
Verify the color palette stays within the 80s neon-on-dark theme
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast intimate duo portrait with geometric, double-layered outline typography for a retro-cinematic aesthetic.
